sentences.text:
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:44700
Court No. - 91
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 2372 of 2024

Applicant :- Rovinder Bindra Alias Robi And Another
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Himanshu Mishra
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mayank Kumar Jain,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for applicants, learned Additional Government Advocate for the State and perused the record.

2. The present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed for quashing the summoning order dated 18.10.2023 and entire proceedings of Criminal Complaint Case No. 14398 of 2022,
under Sections 323, 504, 506, 354-A I.P.C., P.S. Jagdishpura, District Agra, pending in the court of learned Additional Civil Judge (JD)/ Judicial Magistrate.
It is also prayed to stay the further proceeding of aforesaid case during pendency of present application.
3. It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicants that applicant no. 2 is the step mother-in-law of opposite party No. 2.
There are series of litigation against applicant No. 2 and her husband Devendra Pal Singh such as F.I.R. under Sections 498A, 323, 307, 504 I.P.C.
Opposite party No. 2 was also made accused in the said F.I.R.

A suit for interim maintenance has also been filed by Rovinder Bindra Alias Robi And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another on 13 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/53311045/

entities.text: Rovinder Bindra Alias Robi And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: applicant No. 1 against father-in-law of opposite party No. 2 under Section 24 of Hindu Marriage Act.
The said F.I.R. was lodged on 20.10.2022 while present complaint was lodged on 18.10.2023.
It is further submitted that complaint has filed the present complaint as a counter blast to the proceedings initiated by the applicants.
It is submitted that there is no evidence of involvement of applicant in the crime.
No case under Sections323, 504, 506, 354-A I.P.C. is made out against the applicant.

4. Per contra learned Additional Government Advocate opposed the contentions made by learned counsel for the applicants and submitted that opposite party No. 2 has no concern with the litigation which is pending between the applicant No. 2 and her husband, namely, Devendra Pal Singh.
The applicant No. 2 is the step mother-in-law of opposite party No. 2.
It is further submitted that complainant during statement recorded under Section 200 Cr.P.C. and her witness during statement recorded under Section 202 Cr.P.C., have supported the version of F.I.R.
The cognizance order has been passed after considering the evidence available on record, therefore, the present application deserves to be dismissed.

5. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and after going through the available record,
the prayer for quashing of the entire proceedings of aforesaid case, is refused.

6. However, it is provided that in case the applicants applies for bail within a period of 30 days from today, their application for bail shall be considered and disposed of expeditiously in view of law laid down by the Apex Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another, 2022 SCC OnLine SC 825.
7.

entities.text: Satender Kumar Antil vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another, 2022 SCC OnLine SC 825
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: For a period of 30 days or till the applicants surrenders and applies for bail, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicants in the aforesaid case.
8. With the aforesaid directions, this application is finally disposed of.
